checks.title: Ensure Telnet administrative access is disabled on all interfaces
checks.rationale: Telnet communicates all administrative traffic in cleartext, including credentials and firewall configuration. Only SSH and HTTPS should be allowed.
checks.remediation:
config system interface
edit <interface>
unset allowaccess telnet
next
end

checks.title: Ensure unencrypted HTTP administrative access is disabled
checks.rationale: Cleartext HTTP management exposes session tokens and administrator credentials to network eavesdropping. HTTPS must be strictly enforced.
checks.remediation:
config system interface
edit <interface>
unset allowaccess http
next
end

checks.title: Ensure idle administrator timeout is configured to 10 minutes or fewer
checks.rationale: Unattended administrative sessions increase the exposure window for unauthorized modification. Enforce a 10-minute maximum idle timeout.
checks.remediation:
config system global
set admintimeout 10
end

checks.title: Ensure pre-login warning banner is enabled
checks.rationale: A legal notification banner establishes legal notice that access is monitored and unauthorized access is prohibited.
checks.remediation:
config system global
set pre-login-banner enable
end

checks.title: Detect overly permissive firewall policies (permit any-any)
checks.command: show firewall policy | grep -B 2 -A 8 'set action accept' | grep -E 'set srcaddr "all"' | grep -E 'set dstaddr "all"' | grep -E 'set service "ALL"'
checks.rationale: Firewall rules permitting all sources to all destinations across all services defeat network segmentation and violate the principle of least privilege.
checks.remediation: Audit firewall policies and replace blanket any-any rules with explicit source, destination, and application service definitions.

checks.title: Detect unrestricted inbound access (0.0.0.0/0) on sensitive ports (SSH 22, RDP 3389, SMB 445)
checks.rationale: Direct internet exposure of management ports (SSH/RDP) or lateral movement protocols (SMB 445) is a primary initial access vector for ransomware.
checks.remediation: Restrict inbound management ports to dedicated corporate IP ranges, or require SSL-VPN / IPsec gateway authentication before access.

checks.title: Ensure default-deny implicit policy logs all denied traffic
checks.rationale: Logging dropped connection attempts on policy 0 is essential for detecting port scans, reconnaissance, and malicious traffic surges.
checks.remediation:
config firewall policy
edit 0
set logtraffic all
next
end

checks.title: Ensure IPS deep-packet inspection sensor is applied to exposed traffic policies
checks.rationale: Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) inspection signatures detect exploit attempts, protocol anomalies, and vulnerability scans passing through the firewall.
checks.remediation:
config firewall policy
edit <policy-id>
set utm-status enable
set ips-sensor "default"
next
end

checks.title: Ensure remote Syslog server forwarding is enabled
checks.command: show log syslogd setting | grep status
checks.rationale: Security and network audit logs must be shipped in near real-time to an immutable, centralized SIEM repository for compliance and detection.
checks.remediation:
config log syslogd setting
set status enable
set server "<syslog-ip>"
set mode udp
end

checks.title: Ensure NTP time synchronization is configured
checks.rationale: Reliable NTP synchronization ensures timestamps match across firewalls, authentication servers, and SIEM correlators.
checks.remediation:
config system ntp
set status enable
set type FortiGuard
end

checks.title: Ensure default SNMP community strings (public/private) are removed
checks.rationale: Known default community strings allow external attackers or compromised local machines to discover network topology and firewall state.
checks.remediation:
config system snmp community
delete <community-id-for-public>
end
